paragraphs: The Boeing Company ( BO-ing) is an American multinational corporation that designs and manufactures airplanes, rotorcraft, rockets, satellites, and missiles worldwide. The company also provides leasing and product support services. Boeing is among the largest global aerospace manufacturers; it is the fourth-largest defense contractor in the world based on 2022 revenue and is the largest exporter in the United States by dollar value. Boeing was founded in 1916 by William E. Boeing in Seattle, Washington. The present corporation is the result of the Boeing acquisition of McDonnell Douglas on August 1, 1997.

The Boeing Company's corporate headquarters is located in the Crystal City neighborhood of Arlington County, Virginia, near Washington, DC. The company is organized into three primary divisions: Boeing Commercial Airplanes (BCA), Boeing Defense, Space & Security (BDS), and Boeing Global Services (BGS). In 2021, Boeing recorded $62.3 billion in sales. Boeing is ranked 54th on the Fortune 500 list (2020), and ranked 121st on the Fortune Global 500 list (2020).

people.name: Uma M. Amuluru
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer
people.bio: Amuluru joined Boeing in 2017. Her previous positions include Chief Compliance Officer and Vice President, Global Compliance, and Vice President and Assistant General Counsel, Boeing Defense, Space & Security.
people.quote: Ms. Amuluru joined Boeing in 2017 and her previous positions include Vice President and Assistant General Counsel, Boeing Defense, Space & Security

people.name: Dana S. Deasy
people.title: Chief Information Digital Officer and Senior Vice President, Information Digital Technology & Security
people.bio: Deasy previously served as Chief Information Officer for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2018 to 2021. He also held global chief information officer roles at JPMorgan Chase & Co. and BP, Plc.
people.quote: Mr. Deasy most recently served as Chief Information Officer for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2018 to 2021.

people.name: Brett C. Gerry
people.title: Chief Legal Officer and Executive Vice President, Global Compliance
people.bio: Gerry previously served as Boeing's Senior Vice President and General Counsel and as President of Boeing Japan. His earlier positions included Vice President and General Counsel, Boeing Commercial Airplanes.
people.quote: Mr. Gerry previously served as Senior Vice President and General Counsel from May 2019 to May 2020

people.name: Jesus Malave, Jr.
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Malave previously served as Chief Financial Officer of Lockheed Martin and as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of L3Harris Technologies. He serves on the board of GE Vernova Inc.
people.quote: Mr. Malave was elected Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer effective August 15, 2025.

people.name: Howard E. McKenzie
people.title: Chief Engineer and Executive Vice President, Engineering, Test & Technology
people.bio: McKenzie joined Boeing in 1987. He previously served as Vice President and Chief Engineer of Boeing Commercial Airplanes and of Boeing Global Services.
people.quote: Mr. McKenzie joined Boeing in 1987 and his previous positions include Vice President and Chief Engineer of Boeing Commercial Airplanes

people.name: Brendan J. Nelson
people.title: Senior Vice President; President, Boeing Global
people.bio: Nelson previously served as President of Boeing Australia, New Zealand and South Pacific. Before joining Boeing, he was Director of the Australian War Memorial and Australian Ambassador to Belgium, Luxembourg, the European Union and NATO.
people.quote: Dr. Nelson previously served as President of Boeing Australia, New Zealand and South Pacific from February 2020 to January 2023.

people.name: Robert K. Ortberg
people.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Ortberg has served as Boeing's President and Chief Executive Officer and a Board member since August 8, 2024. He previously served as Chief Executive Officer of Collins Aerospace and held leadership positions at Rockwell Collins, including Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer.
people.quote: Mr. Ortberg's previous positions include Special Advisor to the Office of the Chief Executive Officer of RTX Corporation from February 2020 to March 2021
